title: Can I MASTER Sideways Pawns Chess?
summary: The creator plays chess.com Sideways Pawns against online humans (~1490-1690): pawns may also move one square sideways. Goal: win five games; he wins all five (games 1-5), noting the variant mostly matters in pawn endgames and that a recaptured/broken pawn chain can 'slide back into existence'.
rules: Standard starting position and normal chess rules.
Pawns may additionally move one square left or right (sideways) onto an EMPTY square; sideways moves never capture (chess.com Sideways Pawns rule; transcript only states 'pawns can move sideways').
Pawns still capture diagonally forward, promote on the last rank, and can push two from their starting rank.
A pawn may slide back and forth along a rank (transcript 11:27 'this pawn could just slide out of the way all the way back to the king side').
